create_data_loader_from_vrs: create an ATEK raw data loader from a VRS file path with configurable frequency and snippet length
build_efm_dataloader: build an AtekRawDataloaderAsEfm instance with VRS, MPS, and ground truth files for EFM model input
get_model_sample_by_timestamps: get a model-specific sample dictionary from the dataloader given a list of nanosecond timestamps
iterate_dataloader_snippets: iterate over dataloader snippets by index to retrieve EFM-formatted samples from ATEK VRS data
get_timestamps_by_index: get the list of nanosecond timestamps for a given sample index using the temporal subsampler
